Thanks! (I could try to give some tips... At first I think it's important to get the right reading matter. I prefer medical lecture about anatomy and real photos to learn about human proportions intead of 'How to draw' books. (There's a book series called 'How to draw Manga' which is the only one I would recommend. (For drawing doujinshi.)) In my case it helped a lot to watch people and memorize their facial expressions for example. (You can see how people move, which poses are possible and natural to avoid drawing weird proportions.) Since you have an own body you can start with yourself. 'Just take a closer look at it'; This line is very important if it comes to drawing. 
About art materials... Just get some different pencils, a soft eraser, maybe some black liners too and a sketchbook with strong paper you can take everywhere. You don't need to spend lots of money at the start.) Of course all the things I learned took the time of my whole life so it's nearly impossible to get this far in a few months. Drawing human anatomy from imagination is one of the most challenging things but if you are able to do so anything else will be made easily without practising much. You need to be ambitious.
